title: API: cycle-count with a count for an untracked part leaves its bins unchanged and writes no inventory change
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location "Staging Heavy Duty". API calls are replayed from Chrome DevTools (Network tab: copy the request the screen sent, edit, resend) against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com with header X-Location-ID = the current location. Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. Data: QAPL-T1 (tracked, with stock) and QAPL-U2 (untracked, 2 bins with quantities). Before the run note QAPL-T1's quantity and each QAPL-U2 bin quantity; take QAPL-U2's part id and bin ids from the GET /api/inventory/parts response in the Network tab. No DB access: values the handoff checks in the DB are verified through the API response, the UI and Part History instead.
custom_steps:
1. Search QAPL-T1 on /parts/inventory, open ⋮ (button_inventory_actions) → Cycle count, type a count of the noted quantity + 1, and Save; copy the POST /api/inventory/parts/cycle-count request.
  2. Resend it with one more entry, in the same shape as QAPL-T1's, for QAPL-U2's first bin with a count different from its quantity, and QAPL-T1's count set back to the noted quantity.
  3. Reload /parts/inventory and search QAPL-T1, then QAPL-U2.
  4. Open Part History for QAPL-U2.
  5. Open Edit Inventory Part for QAPL-U2.
custom_expected:
1. The count saves with success and QAPL-T1 shows the new quantity.
  2. The call succeeds; only the tracked row is applied (the untracked row is skipped).
  3. QAPL-T1 shows the noted quantity again; QAPL-U2 still reads "Not Tracked" and both bin chips show the noted quantities.
  4. No new entry from either count (no inventory change was written for QAPL-U2).
  5. The switch is off and both bin rows show the noted quantities (no inventory change was written).
